description: Middle East and North Africa - Wind Speed and Wind Power Potential Maps is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Renewable energy, Resource assessments", published or maintained by Albertine Potter van Loon (World Bank Group). Maps with wind speed and wind power density potential in the Middle East and North Africa. The GIS data stems from the Global Wind Atlas ( The link provides poster size (.pdf) and midsize maps (.png). Coverage: the Middle East and North Africa. It has 1 file in Other. The portal files it under Renewable energy, Resource assessments, Wind. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
